packageRules.description: AGENTS.md pins the toolchain to Node 22 LTS and treats .nvmrc as authoritative; never bump the Node version.
Auto-merge minor and patch updates once CI is green.

assets/c8/8.8 and 8.9 pin the camunda/camunda image to a specific test-matrix version (in docker-compose.yml via CAMUNDA_VERSION, and in .env). Renovate has already auto-bumped this pin twice (PR #500, PR #543), breaking the release; do not let it touch these paths again.
